blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · If you've been looking for that effort…
blocks_element.text:
If you've been looking for that effortless, fresh-out-of-the-shower scent that doesn't smell like overwhelming perfume, Glossier You is it. The signature red-capped bottle holds a fragrance designed to blend with your personal chemistry. It opens with a bright, subtle spicy kick of pink pepper before melting into a soft, powdery iris and warm ambroxan base. It smells like a cozy plush blanket, clean laundry, and skin-warm musk. It isn't a "room-filler," but people will definitely ask what you're wearing when they step in close. A total staple for everyday wear!
Bottom line Yes - I would recommend this to a friend
Reviewed on Glossier You
